cell_type.evidence: inferred: Ancient dental calculus human proteins are strongly enriched in extracellular (p-value 3.2e−12, FDR-corrected) and secretory (p-value 4.3e−9, FDR-corrected) proteins, mostly of neutrophil origin.

material_type.evidence: inferred: The research focuses on dental calculus (mineralized plaque), dentine, a carious lesion, and an alveolar bone abscess from the medieval site of Dalheim, Germany (ca. AD 950-1200).

sample_source.evidence: The purpose of this study was to investigate oral microbiome and host proteins in archaeological human dental tissues using a shotgun proteomics approach.

species.evidence: organisms: Homo sapiens (human); Bos taurus (bovine); Ovis

tissue.evidence: organism parts: Alveolar bone; Dental plaque; Tooth
